definition.en: The International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) is a specialized agency of the United Nations that coordinates the principles and techniques of international air navigation and fosters the planning and development of international air transport to ensure safe and orderly growth.
definition.hi: The International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) is a specialized agency of the United Nations that coordinates the principles and techniques of international air navigation and fosters the planning and development of international air transport to ensure safe and orderly growth.

importanceInUpsc.en: For UPSC GS-3, ICAO is significant as it governs the global regulatory framework for aviation, which is a critical component of the infrastructure and external sector of the Indian economy. Understanding its role helps in analyzing India's connectivity, international trade logistics, and compliance with global safety and security standards.
